detection_rule: detected iff fake_R < 0.5 and fake_R_null < 0.9 (both live-measured, no synthetic fallback)
pass_condition: planted_bug_detected true via live /4 detection path; synthetic-only detection is insufficient for discharge (CTRL-RT025-UNPLANTED.yaml companion_live_plant).
falsifies_if: Live plant not detected while summary still claims planted_bug_detected=true.
note: Companion detection path only; does NOT affect the primary unplanted R/R_null reported in R_cell.json (R-1 binding, plant OFF on primary).
